## What I do

I work across the full analytical process: defining the question, preparing and validating data, designing experiments, evaluating models, interpreting results, and communicating what the evidence supports.
::::

::::: {.practice-grid}
::: {.practice-item}
<p class="practice-number">01</p>

### Analytics and decision support

Business intelligence, statistical analysis, experimental design, operational metrics, segmentation, and clear communication for decision-makers.
:::

::: {.practice-item}
<p class="practice-number">02</p>

### Applied AI evaluation

NLP, retrieval-augmented generation, synthetic data, document intelligence, and controlled evaluation of model quality, latency, and reliability.
:::

::: {.practice-item}

Reproducible local and cloud environments for model experimentation, vector retrieval, observability, and GPU-enabled inference.

<p class="project-type">Analytics engineering · Financial data</p>

### Seats-to-Cash

A dbt and Snowflake finance stack that separates ARR expansion from repricing and ties billings, revenue, deferred revenue, and cash together, checked against an answer key.

<div class="project-metric"><strong>15.7%</strong><span>of ARR growth identified as repricing</span></div>

<p class="project-tools">dbt · Snowflake · Hightouch · Salesforce</p>

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/seats-to-cash)
:::

<p class="project-type">Data engineering · Lakehouse</p>

### AdventureWorks Lakehouse

A Databricks medallion lakehouse that turns a broken 72-file export into a tested dbt star schema, MLflow-tracked analyses, and a five-page AI/BI dashboard, deployed as one Asset Bundle.

<div class="project-metric"><strong>0.6%</strong><span>reseller gross margin on about three quarters of revenue</span></div>

<p class="project-tools">Databricks · PySpark · dbt · MLflow</p>

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/adventureworks-lakehouse)
:::

<p class="project-type">Experimental design · LLM evaluation</p>

### Gemma 4 Security-Advisory Evaluation

A controlled local experiment measuring how model size, supplied evidence, reasoning configuration, and temperature affect accuracy, latency, and reliability.

<div class="project-metric"><strong>93.8%</strong><span>accuracy at 0.44 s for E4B, vs 95.6% at 7.08 s for 26B</span></div>

<p class="project-tools">Python · R · Ollama · ANOVA</p>

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/gemma4-eval)
:::
